text.p: Merck & Co Inc said Wednesday that it has launched a new genomics initiative to support development of scientific technology that will lead to linking human genetic traits and resolving biological function of disease genes.

The company said the Merck Genome Research Institute Inc is a non-profit organization to promote and sponsor projects that will enable scientists to develop assays and methodologies which can be applied broadly across genomics research and improve the accuracy and speed in which functional associations can be made with sequences of genetic information.

The initiative provides additional support to the Merck Gene Index Project launched in 1994, which is a public database of gene sequences that allows scientists worldwide unrestricted access to gene sequences and their cDNA clones.
The Institute extends the Project to eventually allow scientists to analyze gene function, a prerequisite for identifying gene targets for drug discovery, Merck said.
